status: Third requested concept refinement; game not implemented

01-building.focus: The same preparation folio as Choose keeper: five slots, selected Mage rank stats/effects and a compact pinned plan.

02-choose-keeper.focus: Archer II base stats and single-target behavior; two potential recipes with one expanded detail.

05-combat.focus: One current-wave summary above DPS; Pause and one Speed button; catalogs stay in the header.

06-current-wave.focus: Combined revealed boss health at top center; current-wave context above DPS; compact controls.

08-recipe-catalog.focus: Find a goal; list rows show built basic ingredients / total required, separately from draft recruits.

09-recipe-navigation.focus: Ingredient progress in list rows; ordered recipe navigation stays separate from exploration history.

03-combination-preview.focus: One transformation and confirmation; preserve existing map badges and remove future odds.

04-ready-defender.focus: Select a defender on the map to inspect; compact Maze plans and Start wave dock.

rules.speedControl: One button cycles existing1x/2x; Pause stays separate
rules.bossHealth: Top-center revealed living boss current/max total
rules.recipeRowCounter: sum ownedCount / sum count; excludes draftCount
rules.buildingActions: Hide Reroll and Reserve until Choosing permits them
rules.collapsedDps: One shallow score / measurement wave / disclosure strip
rules.multipleCombinations: Compact vertical list; one shared expanded detail; preview never crafts
rules.mapBadges: Reuse existing renderer, portraits, role colors and guarded activation
rules.previewOdds: No future-rank odds in combination preview
rules.readyDock: Secondary Maze plans and primary Start wave only
rules.inspection: Select map defender; no Inspect keeper button
rules.sharedPreparationFolio: Building and Choosing share card geometry, detail location and styling; phase controls stay truthful
rules.rankStatistics: Damage / hit, Base direct DPS, Range, Interval from displayed rank
rules.rankEffects: Quantified abilities from the same displayed-rank profile; replace generic description
rules.actualRank: Compare rank only; Keep, Merge and crafting eligibility use actual inventory
rules.baseVsMeasured: Base direct DPS is single-target pre-defense; retained Peak DPS is independent
